items.prompt: A force in N is u=[2, 1, -1]. The allowed direction is v=[1, 2, 2]. Compute the vector projection of u onto v (three coordinates).
items.solution: u·v=2, v·v=9. Multiply v by 2/9. The residual must be orthogonal to v.
